recent.text: The Colts have signed QB Shane Buechele from the Bills practice squad. They were down to two QBs after waiving Daniel Jones. Elsewhere, promising rookie DL Caden Curry has been placed on injured reserve with undisclosed injury.
recent.author: Stephen Holder

recent.text: The #Colts signed QB Shane Buechele off the #Bills' practice squad. He went undrafted in 2021 and has appeared in one NFL game. Indy also placed rookie DE Caden Curry on injured reserve. He'll be out at least the next four games. We don't know his injury, but we'll ask tomorrow.
recent.author: James Boyd

recent.text: Busy roster shuffling for Colts. *Placed DE Caden Curry on IR *Signed QB Shane Buechele off Bills PS. *Signed DE Carl Lawson to active roster from PS. *Waived OT Charlie Heck. *Signed TE Sean McKeon to PS. *Signed DE Cam Sample to PS.
recent.author: Mike Chappell

recent.text: Colts have their new QB3 in Shane Buechele, but the bigger new is Caden Curry going on IR. The rookie has made plays all year and had earned a bigger role the last few weeks. Hoping he can return and finish the year strong.
recent.author: Andrew Moore
recent.quoted_text: We have signed QB Shane Buechele off of the Bills practice squad and signed DE Carl Lawson to the 53-man roster from the practice squad. We have placed DE Caden Curry on IR. We have waived T Charlie Heck and signed TE Sean McKeon and DE Cam Sample to the practice squad.

recent.text: Colts 3rd QB will be Shane Buechele. Signed by the team off the Bills practice squad. 14 career pass attempts. Another roster note, Caden Curry is going to IR.
recent.author: Kevin Bowen
recent.quoted_text: #Colts worked out 3 QBs today: -Seth Henigan -Clayton Tune -Bailey Zappe Henigan was with the team last year. Sounds like they’ll add one at some point this week.

recent.text: #Colts DE Laiatu Latu is playing a career-high 77 percent of the defensive snaps this season, but he only has three sacks through 11 games.
recent.author: James Boyd
recent.quoted_text: #Colts DC Lou Anarumo DE Laiatu Latu: "There's been an uptick in his getting around the QB. It's certainly not where he wants to be. ... Just don't want him to get frustrated because the production isn't where he wants it to be or where we want it to be. ... It's going to come."

recent.text: #Colts OC Jim Bob Cooter, asked why the offense has struggled: "Just had a tough time getting the pass game up to the level that would, shoot, benefit an NFL offense." "We gotta do a better job as a coaching staff putting these guys in position to make plays and go attack ..."
recent.author: James Boyd

recent.text: #Colts OC Jim Bob Cooter on Anthony Richardson Sr.: "We've obviously had an interesting four years at (QB). But Anthony's got to watch a lot of different guys go through their weekly process ... of preparing for an opponent." "It can be nice to have that 10,000 foot view. ..."
recent.author: James Boyd

recent.text: #Colts STC Brian Mason says the kickoff returners will be WRs Ashton Dulin and Anthony Gould. RB Seth McGowan has been a kickoff returner (and a pretty darn good one), but he's out due to a hamstring injury with no timeline on his return.
